# runzero_organization (Data Source)

Fetches a single RunZero organization by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `asset_count` (Number) Number of assets in the organization.
- `client_id` (String) The client ID of the organization.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the organization was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the organization.
- `expiration_assets_offline` (Number) Duration in seconds before assets are marked offline.
- `expiration_assets_stale` (Number) Duration in seconds before assets are marked stale.
- `expiration_integration_attributes` (Number) Duration in seconds before integration attributes expire.
- `expiration_scans` (Number) Duration in seconds before scans expire.
- `expiration_vulnerabilities` (Number) Duration in seconds before vulnerabilities expire.
- `export_token` (String, Sensitive) The organization data export token.
- `export_token_counter` (Number) Number of times the export token has been used.
- `export_token_created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the export token was created.
- `export_token_last_used_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the export token was last used.
- `export_token_last_used_by` (String) Identifier of who last used the export token.
- `inactive` (Boolean) Whether the organization is inactive.
- `keep_latest_integration_attributes` (Boolean) Whether to keep the latest integration attributes.
- `name` (String) The name of the organization.
- `parent_id` (String) The parent organization ID.
- `project` (Boolean) Whether this is a project organization.
- `service_count` (Number) Number of services in the organization.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the organization was last updated.
